title: Implement tickets.sync and tickets.validate Tools
description: Implement two MCP tools: `tickets.sync` for dependency resolution and `tickets.validate` for integrity checking. `tickets.sync` evaluates all ticket dependencies, releases expired leases (FORGEOS-BE009), and moves newly unblocked tickets to READY. `tickets.validate` performs a full integrity check: every ticket exists in exactly one stage directory equivalent, stage field matches, SDLC flows are valid, and no orphans exist.
acceptance_criteria: Sync releases all expired leases using the lease detection from FORGEOS-BE009
Sync evaluates dependency graph for all non-DONE tickets
Tickets with all dependencies in DONE are moved to READY stage
Sync returns a summary of changes made (released, unblocked, errors)
Validate checks each ticket exists in exactly one stage, stage field matches, and SDLC flow is valid
Validate returns a list of integrity errors (empty list means clean)
